entries.text: The Results Explorer build emits read model 21: each result's class, lanes, labels, score, score source and comparison identity now come from the corpus rule modules instead of the stored compliance class, and one median row per platform, variant and version (per-query median times across its ranked runs, with run count and spread) feeds the meta leaderboard, which counts only the newest released version of each variant that has a ranked result. A TPC-derived result's labels now carry the full disclaimer ("Derived from TPC-H. These results do not comply with the TPC-H Specification and must not be compared with official TPC-H results.") instead of a short form, and a result below the TPC minimum scale is labelled "Subscale".
